nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Set as the Error workflow of fictional workflows 01-09. Publish this workflow after import: n8n only runs published error workflows, and only for production runs. Stores only workflow name, failing node and a 200-character message.

parameters.jsCode: const e=$input.first().json;const wf=e.workflow&&typeof e.workflow.name==='string'?e.workflow.name:'unknown workflow';const ex=e.execution||{};const node=ex.lastNodeExecuted||(ex.error&&ex.error.node&&ex.error.node.name)||'unknown node';const raw=ex.error&&typeof ex.error.message==='string'?ex.error.message:'no message';return [{json:{workflow:wf.slice(0,120),node:String(node).slice(0,120),message:raw.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,200),execution_id:String(ex.id??'').slice(0,40)}}];

parameters.content:
## TendReview21
**Purpose:** Error workflow for fictional workflows 01-09.

**Inputs:** n8n Error Trigger (production runs only; publish 21 after import).

**Outputs:** POST /api/failure-log on the fixture API.

**Privacy:** Keeps only workflow name, failing node, a 200-character message and execution ID. No item data.
